definitions.gloss: free time; spare time; open slot
definitions.explanation: An unoccupied period of time in one's schedule, available for other activities. Often used in the context of work, school, or appointments.

examples.japanese: {空|あ}き{時間|じかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I study during my free time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{空|あ}き{時間|じかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I had a little free time open up in the afternoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空|あ}き{時間|じかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返信|へんしん}→返信：14350_henshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませた→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I used the free time between meetings to get through my email replies.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{空|あ}き→空く：11062_aku⟧ (empty, available) and ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (time). Describes gaps or openings in a schedule rather than leisure time in general. Commonly used in workplace and school settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空|あ}き{時間|じかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use one's free time
- {空|あ}き{時間|じかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to have free time open up
- {空|あ}き{時間|じかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use free time effectively
- {空|あ}き{時間|じかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: what to do in one's free time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧: free time, not busy — broader, can imply boredom or having nothing to do
- ⟦{余暇|よか}→余暇：15194_yoka⟧: leisure — formal term for recreational time off from work
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: free time — often used in structured settings like school trips or tours
